# Review packet P3-general_information-02

Priority P3, domain general_information, 3 items. Status of every item: not approved.

**How to review independently:** answer every item below before opening the answer sheet. Then compare, and mark each item ACCEPT / FIX (say what) / REJECT in `decisions.csv` (one row per id). Do not edit the item files; the bank worker applies fixes as draft replacements.

**Check for this domain:** Open the source_url and find the quoted text. Does it support the key exactly, and is the law still current (no amendment)?

## Items

### 1. `CIVIO-D1022-GI-0055`  (both, medium, 30 s)

A store owner asks the police to jail a customer who has not paid a ₱3,000 credit purchase. What does the Constitution say?

- (A) He may be jailed if the debt is above ₱1,000
- (B) No person shall be imprisoned for debt
- (C) He may be jailed by barangay order
- (D) He may be jailed until he pays

### 2. `CIVIO-D1022-GI-0056`  (both, medium, 30 s)

A man was acquitted of a theft under a city ordinance. The prosecutor now charges him for the same act under a national law. What rule applies?

- (A) A new prosecution is allowed within one year
- (B) Acquittal under either the ordinance or the law bars another prosecution for the same act
- (C) A new prosecution is allowed because the laws differ
- (D) Only a conviction, not an acquittal, is a bar

### 3. `CIVIO-D1022-GI-0057`  (both, medium, 30 s)

Congress passes a law punishing an act that was legal when a person did it last year. What does the Constitution say?

- (A) The law is valid if passed by two-thirds
- (B) The law is valid for public officers only
- (C) No ex post facto law shall be enacted
- (D) The law is valid if the President signs it

---

## Answer sheet (open only after answering)

### 1. `CIVIO-D1022-GI-0055`: key (B) No person shall be imprisoned for debt

- Why correct: "No person shall be imprisoned for debt" is correct. Art. III, Sec. 20 forbids imprisonment for debt or non-payment of a poll tax; the creditor must use civil remedies. Source checked word for word against the 1987 Constitution text on lawphil.net.
- (A) No amount makes jailing for debt valid.
- (C) No body may jail someone for debt.
- (D) Imprisonment for debt is forbidden.
- Source: 1987 Const., Art. III, Sec. 20 <https://lawphil.net/consti/cons1987.html>; quote: "No person shall be imprisoned for debt or non-payment of a poll tax"
- File: `docs/research/batches/drafts/gi-applied-2026-10-22.json`

### 2. `CIVIO-D1022-GI-0056`: key (B) Acquittal under either the ordinance or the law bars another prosecution for the same act

- Why correct: "Acquittal under either the ordinance or the law bars another prosecution for the same act" is correct. Art. III, Sec. 21 is the guarantee against double jeopardy, including law and ordinance. Source checked word for word against the 1987 Constitution text on lawphil.net.
- (A) No time window applies.
- (C) Sec. 21 expressly bars it.
- (D) Conviction or acquittal is a bar.
- Source: 1987 Const., Art. III, Sec. 21 <https://lawphil.net/consti/cons1987.html>; quote: "If an act is punished by a law and an ordinance, conviction or acquittal under either shall constitute a bar to another prosecution for the same act"
- File: `docs/research/batches/drafts/gi-applied-2026-10-22.json`

### 3. `CIVIO-D1022-GI-0057`: key (C) No ex post facto law shall be enacted

- Why correct: "No ex post facto law shall be enacted" is correct. Art. III, Sec. 22 bars laws that punish past acts that were innocent when done, and bills of attainder. Source checked word for word against the 1987 Constitution text on lawphil.net.
- (A) No vote can validate an ex post facto law.
- (B) The ban protects everyone.
- (D) Signing cannot cure the ban.
- Source: 1987 Const., Art. III, Sec. 22 <https://lawphil.net/consti/cons1987.html>; quote: "No ex post facto law or bill of attainder shall be enacted"
- File: `docs/research/batches/drafts/gi-applied-2026-10-22.json`
